title: docs(org): default to v2 homepage
body:
<!--

**Summary**

This PR changes the default homepage of InstantSearch.js to V2.

While the V2 docs/* will still be behind
https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/.

Fixes #2236

We may want to add a link to V1 docs so that:

people still on V1 can access the docs easily
people looking for V1 docs content when using v2 can do it (we had this feedback recently, let's dig it)
